us10y_adjustment.status: legacy additive reference; not used by whole-portfolio multiplier scenarios
us10y_adjustment.formula: cumulative deployed notional × ((US10Y close pct − baseline pct) / 100) × elapsed calendar days / 365
us10y_adjustment.holiday_method: user-confirmed: forward-fill last available Treasury close to equity sessions without a Treasury observation; Oct 12 uses Oct 9 close
